notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two other lands, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {4} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of World Shaper.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Mycosynth Gardens, adding {C}{C}.
The Mycosynth Gardens dies, triggering its second ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
